-- Missing requirements for open products
INSERT INTO missingRequirements (productId, requirementKey, required, isMissing, status, sourceSystem, createdAt, updatedAt)
SELECT p.id, rt.`key`, true, true, 'missing', 'system', NOW(), NOW()
FROM products p
CROSS JOIN requirementTypes rt
WHERE p.status IN ('open', 'in_progress') AND rt.required = true
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE updatedAt = NOW();

-- Approval history for submitted product
INSERT INTO approvalHistory (productId, action, fromStatus, toStatus, performedByUserId, note, createdAt)
SELECT p.id, 'submitted', 'in_progress', 'submitted', NULL, 'Alle Pflichtdokumente eingereicht', NOW()
FROM products p WHERE p.status = 'submitted' LIMIT 1
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE productId = productId;
